assumptions.choice: With nothing closed, the flyover and the last 330 m before the fork run at 66 km/h.
assumptions.status: ordinary mornings: AID01103 and AID01104 run at 65 to 71 km/h in every quarter-hour 07:15 to 10:30. The network's own limit there is 50 km/h

assumptions.choice: The slow lane, 44419212_0, closes at 08:54:00 (5,340 s).
assumptions.status: observed at AID01104: first of five readings in a row with no slow-lane vehicle while the fast lane carried traffic; the last reading with it open was 08:50:30

assumptions.choice: While the slow lane alone is closed (08:54:00 to 09:00:30) it is closed to traffic, drivers move over in the last 77 m before the fork, and the fast lane passes the crash at 4.7 km/h.
assumptions.status: observed at AID01104: 19 vehicles in five readings passed in the fast lane, 456 veh/h, at 3 to 9 km/h. 4.7 km/h is the speed at which one lane of this model passes 456 veh/h. The speed applies to the whole 543 m edge; where on it the crash was is not observed. The 77 m is assumed

assumptions.choice: Both lanes close at 09:00:30 (offset 390 s).
assumptions.status: observed at AID01104: every lane empty from 09:00:30. Single readings at 09:09, 09:14 and 09:30:30 show a few vehicles (17 in the five-minute counts 09:05-09:30); E does not model them. TD's 'all lanes' message came at 09:36

assumptions.choice: While both lanes are closed nobody new gets onto the flyover: a driver entering the last 365 m before the fork (edges 814979900 to 1198059120) whose route crosses it takes another route, chosen by SUMO. The only one is Wong Chuk Hang Road under the flyover. The few vehicles already on the flyover drive off it.
assumptions.status: assumed behaviour, supported by the detectors: AID01104 on the flyover counted 17 vehicles in ten bins while AID01103 before the fork kept passing 350 to 550 veh/h

assumptions.choice: While both lanes are closed, traffic in the last 330 m before the fork (edges 814979901#0 to 1198059120) crawls past the scene at 7 km/h.
assumptions.status: calibrated to AID01103's speed, which stands on that stretch: 6 to 13 km/h in the ten bins with a speed, 09:10 to 09:55, median 7. Nothing sets how many vehicles get through; the note compares what the model then passes at AID01103 with the 433 counted

assumptions.choice: Reopening is set by --clearance, counted from the 08:54 onset; 66 minutes gives 10:00:00. For the first 20 minutes E opens only one of the flyover's two lanes and holds the last 330 m before the fork to 22 km/h; then both lanes and the full speed.
assumptions.status: the first reopening is observed at AID01104: last empty reading 09:59:30, traffic again at 10:00:00 (TD reported the incident over at 10:02). The 20 minutes on one lane stand for a narrowed passage at the scene and are inferred, not seen as a closed lane: AID01104, 136 m onto the flyover, shows both lanes carrying traffic from 10:04. What is seen is that the flyover carried only 72 to 120 vehicles a bin, about one lane's flow, at 55 to 65 km/h until 10:20 while AID01103 before the fork was still at 19 to 38 km/h and AID01102 at 7 to 14, so the limit lay between AID01103 and AID01104. AID01103 is back at 65 km/h from 10:20. The note gives the run with no such stage

assumptions.choice: Every vehicle is 6.5 m long, not the demand file's 5 m.
assumptions.status: ASSUMED mean for this road's mix of cars, buses, minibuses and goods vehicles; no classified count is in the repository. It sets how much road a queue of a given size takes. The note gives the score with 5 m

assumptions.choice: Drivers leave when they meet the queue. A driver heading for the fork who reaches one of the three exits at Aberdeen (edges 44577543, 1197441887 and 26560250) in a nearside lane while the traffic just ahead moves under 15 km/h takes the exit with probability 0.4. A driver whom the queue keeps from entering the network at Aberdeen Praya Road gives up with the same probability for each minute of waiting.
assumptions.status: calibrated to AID01101 and AID01102: from 09:15 to 09:45 AID01101 kept counting about 90 vehicles a bin while AID01102, 520 m on, counted about 30, more than the road between them can store, and the queue reached AID01101 between 09:45 and 09:50. Where those drivers went is not observed. The note gives the runs with nobody leaving and with other shares

assumptions.choice: A driver who leaves the corridor is charged 20 minutes of delay for the rest of the trip, which the model does not contain.
assumptions.status: ASSUMED, NO SOURCE. The run report states this part of the delay separately so that it can be recomputed with another figure

assumptions.choice: TD's messages time what an operator could know, not the closure: first report 09:01, all lanes 09:36, end 10:02.
assumptions.status: observed report times

assumptions.choice: Plan actions. The od groups are the flyover's traffic by where it leaves the network: the Canal Road Flyover (485146382) or Wong Nai Chung Road (1194711688). 'Wong Chuk Hang Road' is the road under the flyover, off at edge 1198059138 and back on at 1198059128. 'Wong Chuk Hang Road / Tong Bin Lane' is the second signal on it; its green for Wong Chuk Hang Road eastbound is phase 0 of the network's program.
assumptions.status: the routes are the only detour the network contains. The signal is an ASSUMED NETWORK CONTROL, not a sourced TD control: its program is netconvert's guess, 24 s of green in 90 s, the real timing and whether TD can extend it are not in any source we have, and in this model the signal is not what limits the surface road
